laws.title: Electric Vehicle (EV) Charging Station and Natural Gas Vehicle (NGV) Policies for Condominiums
laws.sum: Condominium associations may not prohibit or restrict the installation or use of an EV charger or NGV fueling station in a homeowner’s designated parking space.
